sources.title: Unlimited-OCR - AI Model Library | Build on Vast.ai
sources.snippet: Unlimited-OCR is a multimodal OCR and document-parsing model from Baidu, built for one-shot long-horizon document understanding. It reads images and pages and produces structured text output, extending the ideas behind DeepSeek-OCR toward parsing long documents in a single pass.

sources.snippet: In-depth review of Baidu's open-source Unlimited-OCR: a 3B-parameter local OCR model with 32K context window that reads 100-page PDFs in one pass at 93% accuracy. R-SWA mechanism explained, local deployment guide, comparison with Tesseract/PaddleOCR/cloud OCR.

sources.snippet: Unlimited-OCR is an open-source optical character recognition model developed by Baidu that uses a causal language modeling architecture to extract text from images with theoretically unlimited length processing capabilities.
